rationale: Clear motor vehicle accident (rear-end collision) with both vehicle damage and personal injury sustained by the claimant in the accident.
claim_summary: POL-1003 rear-end collision at Route 9 red light; vehicle totaled with severe trunk damage; claimant injured with whiplash and sprained wrist; third-party liability established.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat; vehicle totaled
case_facts.injury_party: Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
case_facts.third_party_insurance: Other driver's insurance info on police report

rationale: Vehicle parked in driveway suffered damage (smashed hood and windshield) from fallen tree; this is vehicle damage covered under auto, not a separate property_damage or liability claim.
claim_summary: Vehicle parked in driveway suffered medium-severity damage (smashed hood and windshield) when maple tree from own property fell during windstorm; auto damage claim under POL-1005.

case_facts.damage_description: Maple tree from own front yard fell during wind; hood and windshield smashed on car
case_facts.property_affected: Vehicle (car parked in driveway); tree from own property
